sections.Profile:
"Lost In Space" is a pinball machine released by Sega Pinball, Inc. in May 1998, themed around the sci-fi TV series. It features two flippers, a dot matrix display, and is part of the Sega/Stern Whitestar generation. The machine had a limited production run of 600 units.

- Manufacturer: Sega Pinball Inc. (US)
- Years made: 1998
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 6
- Tags: Licensed, 1990s, Solid State
